considerations.sourcePassage: I'm sure you've seen a cartoon that looks like this many times. The idea that a normal cell, starting off here, acquires a mutation, and maybe a second mutation, and it becomes slightly abnormal.
considerations.reason: The rewrite conflates the cartoon with the idea ('The core idea is the familiar cartoon in which...'), but this is a stylistic consolidation that accurately conveys the biological premise.

considerations.sourcePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that will precipitate cancer, and they can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events that can also help to give rise to cancer.
considerations.reason: The rewrite changes 'they' (referring to the viruses) to 'infection', which is a minor stylistic variation that preserves the original meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: So there's a lot of changes that occur, and as I said, we don't know pretty much because of this when they occur.
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders this as 'Many changes therefore occur, and because of this it is largely not known when they occur', which functions as a transitional summary of the genetic, epigenetic, and infectious factors discussed rather than an unsourced causal claim.
